gappers.catalyst: Confirmed: selected for S&P 500 index inclusion (announced Fri Sep 4/5), extending Friday's +7.35% surge
gappers.catalyst_detail: Bloom Energy was selected for S&P 500 index inclusion, triggering forced buying from index funds that must hold all constituents -- shares surged 7.35% on the announcement session (Friday) and are extending gains today (+8.75%) as index funds continue building positions ahead of the effective addition date. Layered on an already-strong fundamental base: Q1 2026 revenue +130% YoY ($751.1M), Q2 revenue +166% YoY, plus the ongoing AI-data-center power-shortage narrative (fuel cells as grid-independent power for AI data centers) that drove this morning's 08:15 ET deep-dive.
gappers.why: S&P 500 inclusion is a hard, mechanical catalyst -- index funds tracking trillions in assets must buy to match the index, creating durable multi-day buying pressure independent of sentiment. Combined with genuine hypergrowth fundamentals and the AI-power-shortage narrative, this pulls in passive-flow buyers and active momentum/thematic buyers simultaneously.
gappers.impact: Highest-quality catalyst combination among today's gappers -- mechanical (index-fund) + fundamental (revenue hypergrowth) + thematic (AI power). More durable than a pure headline spike since index buying continues until rebalance completes. Risk: stock is ~5x off its 52-week low at a rich multiple (~285x trailing PE per this morning's research), so a lot of good news may already be priced in.
gappers.horizon: LONG_TERM leaning for the index-inclusion/fundamental combination (permanent inclusion, structural revenue growth), but SHORT_TERM tape risk remains given how extended the stock already is.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Strongest combined catalyst of today's top 5, but also the most extended entry (near highs, rich valuation) -- a 10% trailing stop risks a wide dollar loss per share. Given the 3-trades/week and 20%-per-position caps, RGTI's dated contract catalyst at a less-extended valuation may offer better R:R for similar AI-infra theme exposure.
